Backtest the model on a dataset in-process, scored as chap-core scores it. Returns 202; the

parameters.name: period_type
parameters.description: `monthly` or `weekly` (default: the model's period type, else monthly).

parameters.name: include_geo
parameters.description: Default: whether the model requires geo.

post.summary:
Search the model's hyperparameters (random or grid over its `hpo_search_space`), each trial
an in-process backtest. Returns 202; the trials, the best config and its backtest are stored
as an `ml_hpo` artifact, and with `create_config` the best config is created.
chapkit-rs extension; not part of Python chapkit.

model is kept warm in memory, so repeated calls cost only the model itself.

ArtifactIn.description: An artifact to create or replace.

level.description: Ignored: the level is computed from the parent.

ArtifactTreeNode.description: An artifact in a tree view.

config_id.description: A stored config; or give `config`, or neither for the defaults.

BacktestRequest.description: `POST /api/v1/ml/$backtest`: a backtest of the model on `data`.

BacktestSettings.description:
Backtest settings of `$backtest` and `$hpo`: chap-core's `BacktestParams` and its dataset
preparation, each optional.

drop_untrained.description: Leave out locations with no target before the test windows (default true).

fill_gaps.description: Fill gaps in a location's periods (default true).

pad.description: Pad locations to the full period range (default true).

periods.description: Periods per forecast (default: the config's `prediction_periods`, else 3).

ConfigIn.description: A config to create or replace.

ExplainRequest.description: `POST /api/v1/ml/$explain`: explain one forecast cell of a trained model.

features.description: Covariates to explain (default: every numeric covariate in `future`).

geo.description: Passed to every model call, as in `$predict`.

lags.description: Historic periods perturbed under `temporal`. Default 3, at most 52.

location.description: Location of the cell to explain.

n_samples.description: Perturbations (LIME) or sampled coalitions (SHAP above 12 features). Default 500.

scope.description:
`temporal` (default): the cell's covariates, their earlier values and the target's
history; `row`: the cell's covariates only.

time_period.description: Period of the cell to explain.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall time of the explanation, all model calls included.

HealthState.description: Health of one check or of the whole service.

checks.description: Per-check results; omitted when there are no checks.

config_id.description: A stored config whose options every candidate is merged into; or give `config`.

create_config.description: Store the best config as a new config (default false).

grid_points.description: Points a continuous float range is split into by `grid` with `grid_ranges` (default 5).

grid_ranges.description: Let `grid` step through ranges; chap-core's grid takes choices only (default false).

HpoRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/ml/$hpo`: a hyperparameter search over the model's search space, each trial a
backtest on `data`.

finished_at.description: When it reached a terminal state.

ListOrPage_ArtifactOut.description:
A list response: a plain array, or a [`Paginated`] page when both `page` and `size`
are given. Used for OpenAPI documentation of list endpoints.

ListOrPage_ConfigOut.description:
A list response: a plain array, or a [`Paginated`] page when both `page` and `size`
are given. Used for OpenAPI documentation of list endpoints.

pages.description: Number of pages (0 when there are no items).
Number of pages (0 when there are no items).

instance.description: The request path or URL the problem occurred on.

Problem.description:
A problem+json response body. `None` fields are omitted, extensions are
flattened into the top level.

RunInfoIn.description: Runtime context chap-core attaches to train and predict requests.

SystemInfo.description: Host information, shaped like servicekit's system response.

python_version.description: Always null: this is a Rust service. Kept for shape compatibility.

ValidateRequest.description: `POST /api/v1/ml/$validate`: a train or predict body plus `type`.

geo.description: Passed to the model's own checks.
